title: In-Place Home Resale Vacant-Home Check: Home-Length Addition
content:
**Rate sheet footnote — longer homes.** Where an In-Place Home Resale package charges for the vacant-home check, the month's check carries a check-size addition, added together with the package's monthly vacant-home check fee into the check subtotal. The check-size addition follows the length of the home recorded on the seller's Home-Site Lease: a home of 70 feet or longer adds 15.00, a home of at least 56 but under 70 feet adds 10.00, and a shorter home adds nothing.

| Home length on the Home-Site Lease | Check-size addition |
|---|---|
| 70 feet or longer | 15.00 |
| 56 feet up to but not including 70 feet | 10.00 |
| under 56 feet | 0.00 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical homes).** A 70-foot home adds 15.00; a 69.5-foot home adds 10.00; a 56-foot home adds 10.00; a 55-foot home adds nothing. The addition reads the length alone; single-section and multi-section homes of the same length add the same amount.
